thread:
incident-bot: [P0] Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/streams (hosted API) — streaming disconnects spike, gateway errors increasing. auto-escalate to oncall.

alice-sre: saw the alert, looking. paging right now.

bob-runtime: grabbing runtime logs, any recent deploys to streaming stack?

deploy-bot: deploy completed: runtime-service v2.14.3 to prod at 1781233300 by jenkins (canary->stable)

alice-sre: ok there was a deploy ~2k seconds ago. starting with proxy/nginx and LB metrics.

carla-cs: heads up — support getting realtime reports from two customers about truncated streams and client-side EOFs. ticket IDs 4521, 4524.

dan-oncall: I'm taking over the pager — +1. will run smoke tests and check backend timeouts.

alice-sre: quick numbers: 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% -> 6.8% in last 10m for streaming route. 502 and 504 are dominant.

eve-devex: do we have distribution by region/customers? could be a regional infra blip.

frank-eng-sre: checking edge LB -> most 502s originate from gateway behind nginx proxy pool a3-us-west-2. upstreams reporting EOF while sending chunked body.

bob-runtime: that sounds like client cancellations or backend process OOM/killed. logs show a lot of 'write: broken pipe' and 'upstream prematurely closed connection'.

alice-sre: reproducing locally against canary shows chunked response streaming fine. suggests either proxy timeout or transient resource exhaustion under increased concurrency.

carla-cs: affected customers are on hosted tier, high concurrency streams. Could be large context lengths + many parallel streams.

dan-oncall: mitigation plan suggestion: 1) throttle max concurrent streams per IP for 15m, 2) route streaming traffic to dedicated pool (if available), 3) rollback runtime deploy if correlation confirmed.

bob-runtime: quick check: runtime-service v2.14.3 includes a small change to KV cache flush timing and keepalive settings. revert would be safe if we confirm.

alice-sre: rolling back not yet — need strong signal. I'll bump nginx proxy timeouts to 90s and increase proxy_buffers as an immediate config patch on gateways in the impacted pool.

frank-eng-sre: applying proxy timeout patch to a3-us-west-2 now (taking one node at a time).

alice-sre: temporary routing: creating a traffic rule to send 30% of streaming traffic to dedicated-pool-2 where utilisation low.

deploy-bot: network-rule update: flow-split applied at 1781234050 by alice-sre (30% -> dedicated-pool-2).

carla-cs: notifying customers that we are investigating and applying mitigations. ETA message drafted. :lock:

bob-runtime: while patching, I'm tailing runtime logs for backpressure events. grep shows repeated 'client canceled context' logged ~500x in last 5m for stream sessions >5s.

alice-sre: interesting — is it upstream closing or client-side timeout? check proxy keepalive and upstream read timeouts.

bob-runtime: upstream read_timeout was default 60s, but many of these streams are shorter; main pattern is chunked encoding chunk write failing after some time. suspect proxy buffering + clients aggressively closing when first chunk delayed.

dan-oncall: short-term: enable shorter initial chunk (send a small keepalive chunk quickly) on the runtime to convince proxies/clients to keep connection open. Can we enable chunked-keepalive header for 10% traffic?

bob-runtime: yes can flip feature-flag enable-early-chunk for runtime-service canary. doing that now.

alice-sre: after increasing proxy timeouts and switch + early-chunk, error rate dropping to ~2.1% in the affected pool. still above baseline but trending down.

frank-eng-sre: thumbs up on the trend. let's keep traffic split for 30m and watch for regressions.

carla-cs: CS updated customers with current mitigations and MTR we will share. They asked if any data lost — looks like partial streaming only, no persisted inference state lost.

bob-runtime: root-cause hypothesis: combination of runtime keepalive change (v2.14.3) + proxy buffer/timing differences under high concurrency causing upstream to close streams while clients retry/abort.

alice-sre: next steps: 1) run a controlled rollback test for v2.14.3 on a small subset (canary vs stable), 2) collect full stack traces for closed connections, 3) create revert patch if correlation confirmed.

dan-oncall: I'll own the rollback test. doing a staged rollback for 10% of runtime instances to v2.14.2 now. will monitor.

deploy-bot: rollback job started at 1781234405 by dan-oncall.

alice-sre: monitoring metrics — 10% rollback group shows error rate back to ~0.4%. strong signal.

bob-runtime: confirmed — v2.14.3 change to keepalive logic introduced a race where long-lived chunked responses could hit a path that closed upstream fds under load. creating immediate revert PR.

carla-cs: customer impact summary for SEV-1 report: start 1781234440, peak error rate 6.8%, primary symptoms: streaming disconnects and client-side cancellations, affected subset of hosted customers on high concurrency, mitigation: proxy timeout bump + early-chunk + 30% traffic diversion + rollback staged -> full revert planned.

alice-sre: creating incident timeline and will hand off to postmortem owners. tagging @bob-runtime and @frank-eng-sre.

dan-oncall: handing off to next oncall in 30m — @frank-eng-sre will take post-incident monitoring and PM. I'll update rotations.

frank-eng-sre: acknowledged. I'll keep watches for 2 hours and follow up with a concise RCA draft.

carla-cs: thanks team. CS will send customer follow-up email once we have final revert and timeline.

incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated at 1781234678. Actions: revert PR, postmortem, update runbook for streaming timeouts.

alice-sre: closing thread for live mitigation. leaving notes for postmortem: add tests for early-chunk behavior, add invariant for keepalive changes to require perf soak at scale.

bob-runtime: PR #7890 opened to revert v2.14.3 keepalive change. linking to postmortem when ready.

frank-eng-sre: added follow-up tasks to oncall board. :white_check_mark:

carla-cs: filed customer communication draft, will wait for final timeline.

end of thread
